verdict.rationale: Anytype's own Queries feature lets you define criteria and get an instantly answered, auto-updating View, and the app is offline-first with all content stored locally, so criteria-based retrieval works without a connection. However, the pack never documents an in-app full-text search, and never names tag, property or path filters; the only 'search' mentions come from the API and AI-agent toolkit. Missing for 10: documented in-app full-text search, explicit filters on tags/properties/paths, evidence of search performance at scale, independent hands-on corroboration of offline search.
